text.p: VideoLan Technologies Inc said on Tuesday it had revenues well in excess of $500,000 for the third quarter ended September 30, and it expected sales and shipments to grow rapidly in the fourth quarter into 1997.
The desktop video networks developer said in a statement it began shipping its VL2000 Desktop Video Conferencing and Video Distribution System with its new ISDN gateway near the end of the quarter.

VideoLan said sales and shipments were set to grow based on orders already booked, sales cycles already in progress and applications for its VL2000 Desktop Video Conferencing and Video Distribution System.
The company said its system had been very well accepted in the marketplace and it was now focusing on a marketing and advertising campaign for it.
